passage.text: Bangkok is a busy city with a huge population.
passage.reading: ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz ə ˈbɪzi ˈsɪti wɪð ə ˈhjuːdʒ ˌpɑːpjəˈleɪʃən.

passage.text: Every day, a huge amount of plastic is used in the city.
passage.reading: ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ, ə ˈhjuːdʒ əˈmaʊnt əv ˈplæstɪk ɪz ˈjuːzd ɪn ðə ˈsɪti.

passage.text: Food is sold in plastic boxes, drinks come with plastic straws, and almost everything is put in a plastic bag.
passage.reading: ˈfuːd ɪz ˈsoʊld ɪn ˈplæstɪk ˈbɑːksɪz, ˈdrɪŋks ˈkʌm wɪð ˈplæstɪk ˈstrɔːz, ənd ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪz ˈpʊt ɪn ə ˈplæstɪk ˈbæɡ.

passage.text: Only a small amount of this plastic is recycled.
passage.reading: ˈoʊnli ə ˈsmɔːl əˈmaʊnt əv ˈðɪs ˈplæstɪk ɪz riːˈsaɪkəld.

passage.text: A lot of it is thrown into canals and rivers, and then it is carried to the sea.
passage.reading: ə ˈlɑːt əv ɪt ɪz ˈθroʊn ɪntə kəˈnælz ənd ˈrɪvərz, ənd ˈðɛn ɪt ɪz ˈkærid tə ðə ˈsiː.

passage.text: Plastic in the ocean is a serious problem.
passage.reading: ˈplæstɪk ɪn ði ˈoʊʃən ɪz ə ˈsɪriəs ˈprɑːbləm.

passage.text: Turtles often eat plastic bags because the bags look like food.
passage.reading: ˈtɜːrtəlz ˈɔːfən ˈiːt ˈplæstɪk ˈbæɡz bɪˈkɔːz ðə ˈbæɡz ˈlʊk laɪk ˈfuːd.

passage.text: Over many years, it breaks into very small pieces, and these pieces harm fish and birds.
passage.reading: ˈoʊvər ˈmɛni ˈjɪrz, ɪt ˈbreɪks ɪntə ˈvɛri ˈsmɔːl ˈpiːsɪz, ənd ˈðiːz ˈpiːsɪz ˈhɑːrm ˈfɪʃ ənd ˈbɜːrdz.

passage.text: Many beaches near Bangkok are now badly polluted.
passage.reading: ˈmɛni ˈbiːtʃɪz ˈnɪr ˈbæŋkɑːk ər ˈnaʊ ˈbædli pəˈluːtɪd.

passage.text: But some university students are working hard to change this.
passage.reading: bʌt sʌm ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˈstuːdənts ər ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ˈhɑːrd tə ˈtʃeɪndʒ ˈðɪs.

passage.text: Every month, they go to a beach near the city for a beach clean-up.
passage.reading: ˈɛvri ˈmʌnθ, ðeɪ ˈɡoʊ tə ə ˈbiːtʃ ˈnɪr ðə ˈsɪti fər ə ˈbiːtʃ ˌkliːn ʌp.

passage.text: Last month, they picked up more than two hundred bags of trash in one morning.
passage.reading: ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ, ðeɪ ˈpɪkt ˈʌp ˈmɔːr ðən ˈtuː ˈhʌndrəd ˈbæɡz əv ˈtræʃ ɪn ˈwʌn ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

passage.text: The group also visits schools in order to teach children about the ocean.
passage.reading: ðə ˈɡruːp ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈvɪzɪts ˈskuːlz ɪn ˈɔːrdər tə ˈtiːtʃ ˈtʃɪldrən əˈbaʊt ði ˈoʊʃən.

passage.text: "We can't clean every beach," says Ploy, one of the students.
passage.reading: wiː ˈkænt ˈkliːn ˈɛvri ˈbiːtʃ, ˈsɛz ˈplɔɪ, ˈwʌn əv ðə ˈstuːdənts.

passage.text: "But if fewer people use plastic, fewer turtles will be harmed."
passage.reading: bʌt ɪf ˈfjuːər ˈpiːpəl ˈjuːz ˈplæstɪk, ˈfjuːər ˈtɜːrtəlz wɪl bi ˈhɑːrmd.
